- Last day of work: September 30, 2025
- Length of service: 7 years and 5 months

A fraction of at least 6 months is considered one whole year. Since 5 months is less than 6 months, only 7 full years are counted.

1. One-half month pay = ₱24,600 ÷ 2 = ₱12,300
2. Separation pay (1/2 month pay per year) = 7 years × ₱12,300 = ₱86,100
3. One month pay = ₱24,600
4. Higher amount = ₱86,100
